purpose: AXI4-Lite总线转换，AW/W分开保存，B/R背压保持。
interfaces: clk、aresetn与五个AXI通道；address/commit/write_access/write_data/read_data为寄存器内接口。无效对齐/范围/字节写返回SLVERR。

declarations.name: ss_axi_lite_regs
declarations.declaration:
module ss_axi_lite_regs (
 input wire clk, aresetn,
 input wire [11:0] s_axi_awaddr,input wire [2:0] s_axi_awprot,
 input wire s_axi_awvalid,output wire s_axi_awready,
 input wire [31:0] s_axi_wdata,input wire [3:0] s_axi_wstrb,
 input wire s_axi_wvalid,output wire s_axi_wready,
 output reg [1:0] s_axi_bresp,output reg s_axi_bvalid,input wire s_axi_bready,
 input wire [11:0] s_axi_araddr,input wire [2:0] s_axi_arprot,
 input wire s_axi_arvalid,output wire s_axi_arready,
 output reg [31:0] s_axi_rdata,output reg [1:0] s_axi_rresp,
 output reg s_axi_rvalid,input wire s_axi_rready,
 output wire [6:0] address,output wire commit,write_access,format_error,
 output wire [31:0] write_data,input wire [31:0] read_data
);

purpose: PS版寄存器层；与SPI版相同公开字段，增加host_stop保留快照的停用入口。
interfaces: host_stop来自同步总线复位；冷rst_n才清队列。普通PS复位清使能、角度影子和看门狗，不能自动恢复动作。

declarations.name: ss_ps_control_regs
declarations.declaration:
module ss_ps_control_regs #(
    parameter integer ACTUATOR_BOUND=0, CLK_FREQ_HZ=61440000,
    parameter integer SERVO_MAX=180, MECHANICAL_MIN=0, MECHANICAL_MAX=180
)(
    input wire clk, rst_n, host_stop,
    input wire [6:0] address,
    input wire commit,write_access,format_error,input wire [31:0] write_data,
    output reg [31:0] read_data,
    output wire irq,servo_pwm,
    input wire feature_valid,
    output wire feature_ready,
    input wire [959:0] feature_pairs,
    input wire [31:0] feature_flags,
    input wire compute_draining,
    input wire [11:0] source_faults,
    output wire run_enable,
    output reg stop_pulse,
    output wire [31:0] fault_status,
    output wire motion_permit,
    output wire counter_exhausted
);

purpose: 片内CPU控制入口，组合AXI转换和PS寄存器层。
interfaces: S_AXI为32位AXI4-Lite、12位局部地址；clk61.44MHz。rst_n为PL冷复位，aresetn为PS总线复位。
